purpose: Evaluate descriptive composition information beyond the already implemented Q median split using the same saved finite teams, fixed panel background and candidate set; no new fusion and no prediction or causal-independence claim.
primary_scope: ordinary_manual primary-target finite panels; doorway and special-range excluded
baseline: Q_MEDIAN2 exact full team count vector within each panel
shared_team_domain: All 45 frozen Manual methods known for every team member; each metric compared on the same finite teams
quantities: within Q plus candidate composition variance
not_controlled: continuous historical Q within each Q bin
all members outside the frozen panel
coarse_Q_limitation: If an increment exists, it is extra information beyond this specific coarse Q-count descriptor; it need not be independent of continuous Q or low-tail Q.
complexity_diagnostic: 128 fixed-seed permutations of candidate labels within Q_MEDIAN2 worker strata separately for each panel; preserves candidate class size within Q strata. Report aggregate randomized-label reference, not independent-sample p-values.
weighting: panel equal within target pool, target equal within image, image equal within building; ratio after variance aggregation; image weighting also retained
missing: Each metric uses finite values only; no missing Q=0; zero-total-variance ratios remain missing; singleton groups cannot be described as stable.
relationship_to_ABC: This supplements existing strict ABC and does not replace or relabel it. No new A/B/C events are claimed.
